locations_store_type_matches_type.name: locations_store_type_matches_type
locations_store_type_matches_type.value: ("locations"."type" = 'store' and "locations"."store_type" is not null) or ("locations"."type" <> 'store' and "locations"."store_type" is null)

products_unit_matches_measurement.name: products_unit_matches_measurement
products_unit_matches_measurement.value: ("products"."measurement_type" = 'count' and "products"."unit" = 'piece') or ("products"."measurement_type" = 'weight' and "products"."unit" in ('kg', 'g')) or ("products"."measurement_type" = 'volume' and "products"."unit" in ('litre', 'ml'))

stock_movements_has_location.name: stock_movements_has_location
stock_movements_has_location.value: "stock_movements"."source_location_id" is not null or "stock_movements"."destination_location_id" is not null

stock_movements_locations_differ.name: stock_movements_locations_differ
stock_movements_locations_differ.value: "stock_movements"."source_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."destination_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."source_location_id" <> "stock_movements"."destination_location_id"
